text:
Situation: Cefepime inventory across Corvale sites ranges from 5.5 to 20.8 days on hand. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC cefepime hydrochloride injection appears on FDA's shortage list as discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-02-10. No public FDA shortage signal exists for the plants named on our current labels (HIKMA FARMACÊUTICA (PORTUGAL) and ACS DOBFAR). Apotex Corp. is the recommended buying option and is not on FDA's shortage list today; its label does not name a plant we could place.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC cefepime hydrochloride injection as discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-02-10.

Our position: We will pursue Apotex Corp. as the primary purchase source while monitoring B. Braun Medical Inc., Baxter Healthcare Corporation, Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, and Qilu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. as alternatives. None of these alternatives appear on FDA's shortage list today, and none provide a plant we could place on their labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Apotex Corp. — approved by pharmacy director.
2. Buyer to qualify B. Braun Medical Inc., Baxter Healthcare Corporation, Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, and Qilu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. as backup suppliers — approved by pharmacy director.
3. Buyer to track daily inventory at each Corvale site and report to P&T committee weekly — approved by pharmacy director.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative agents or changing dosing protocols; those are clinical decisions for the treating clinicians and the committee.
